summary: HomeGallery is a self-hosted web application designed to help you browse personal photos and videos through a browser. It includes features for tagging media, accessing the interface from mobile devices, and using artificial intelligence for image discovery.
goodFor: It is a suitable choice if you want to organise and search a personal media collection on your own hardware using containerised tools.
watchOut: The project currently lacks tagged releases and has a low maintenance score, which indicates that you may encounter unresolved bugs or an abandoned codebase.
deployNotes: Since it runs via Docker and Node.js, you will typically need to configure persistent volume mounts for your media library and place the container behind a reverse proxy for TLS termination.
